decisions.decision: jcommander-1.71 pin recorded as UNVERIFIED (outcome: not performed)
decisions.rationale: com.beust:jcommander:1.71 was never published to Maven Central (metadata goes 1.69 -> 1.72, verified via the GCS mirror's genuine NoSuchKey). A third-party aggregating proxy serves a byte-identical artefact, but the maintainer explicitly declined to accept a proxy as provenance.

decisions.decision: The repo1.maven.org key_link in 77-03 was deliberately left unsatisfied
decisions.rationale: Satisfying it would have required writing a Maven Central citation into formatter-verifier.ts, fabricating the exact provenance claim the maintainer declined.

decisions.decision: All three pins are change-detection only; none carries verified upstream provenance
decisions.rationale: Two are proprietary BASIS builds with no public feed; the third is absent from Central and its original channel (JCenter) was sunset in 2021.

decisions.decision: Executors dispatched sequentially on the main working tree
decisions.rationale: workflow.use_worktrees=false, so ISOLATION resolves to none; --force-isolation none written as the final dispatch-isolation call.

context_notes: Phase 77 is a 7-wave strictly-serial chain, executed via gsd-executor subagents on the main tree. Waves 1-4 are complete and spot-checked. The whole phase directory is git-excluded (D-18 embargo) via .git/info/exclude, so SUMMARY/evidence files live on disk and are never committed - only STATE.md/ROADMAP.md commits mark plan progress. Two things bit this session and are recorded as anti-patterns in .continue-here.md: an executor self-check reporting PASSED while an explicit success criterion was unmet, and vitest rejecting unknown CLI flags by aborting instantly in a way that reads like a fast clean run.
